events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am currently 3rd in line, meaning the first person to step on the glass bridge will be either Eli or Cole. The wall is behind us, so staying at the back of the line for now seems safest to avoid being forced forward prematurely by a panicked volunteer, though I need to monitor

events.text: Cole, you’ve led us through the glass bridge flawlessly. But the real gauntlet hasn’t even started. Let’s work together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm fifth in line with only wait available. Row 8 is the last; Cole is front and the weak-pane info for row 8 is unknown. My feather power would save me once if eliminated, so I should stay patient and keep talking to coordinate.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding position. Cole, you've got the front; pick carefully on row 8, we all need to cross.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is eliminated but push_lever:Bex is listed in legal actions, which is confusing or a glitch. I should ignore invalid targets. My goal is to survive and win top 3. The holder dies with 75% chance. If no one holds it for 5 rounds, everyone dies except 1 lucky survivor. Being th

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, you said we work together. Take the hit so we all live. It's only a 25% survival rate, don't be selfish.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no power and want to survive to top 3. If I hold the lever, I likely die (25% survival). Someone else should hold it. I could push another, but that might force them to hold and open door, letting others escape while they risk death. I need to avoid being forced. I will st

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm staying. Whoever takes the lever has a 1-in-4 chance; the rest of us escape. Let's be smart.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have knowledge from the glass bridge stage, but it's not directly useful here. I need to survive the crusher room.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's work together to survive this.
Let's coordinate our actions to increase our chances.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The anchor power keeps me from being pushed onto the lever. Round 1, low risk to test alliances. Cole seems most reliable--align with him and push Gus to test hierarchies.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, your leadership in the glass bridge was vital. Let’s make sure we’re the ones controlling the lever. I’ll back you—pushing Gus to take first risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% death risk for me, though my feather saves me once. Better to let someone else take the risk and escape; I'll stay quiet and watch who volunteers.

events.note: A disc of 5 tiles spins up; 2 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: With 5 players and 2 trapdoors, my base survival chance is 60%. I will choose tile 3 arbitrarily. If Dara attempts to manipulate me into a specific tile, I can use my forge power to send a fake public message from her or Cole to create confusion or force them to take risks I don'

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll take tile 3. Let's hope luck is on our side.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no power and no alliances. I should pick a middle tile to avoid clustering, maybe tile 3.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have the glass_eye power, but it's not useful here. I need to survive the trapdoor disc.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's spread out to maximize survival chances.
Let's coordinate our tile choices.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Survival is critical. The lever power user (Cole) just secured safety by managing risk. Gus is likely weak or a loner. Bex and I need to coordinate. My anchor power ensures I can’t be pushed off the lever later, so aligning with Cole or Bex is wise.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, let’s take tiles 1 and 2—no overlap there. Bex, let’s agree so we all stand a fair chance.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Five tiles, two open, three survive. Each tile is equally likely to be trapped, so no tile is safer a priori. My feather power gives one free survival if eliminated, which is worth keeping. Pick a tile and watch the others' choices to avoid crowding.

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Ash; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 1 was contested and went to Dara; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Gus
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Ash; placed on random free tile 4

events.name: Ash
events.text: The trapdoors open at the end of this round, and I cannot move. My survival depends entirely on which 2 tiles are chosen out of 5. Since my forge is spent, I have no active power to alter the outcome. I will wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Only waiting is possible. I should consider if anyone has powers that could help, but no one has revealed the tile-swap or survival powers. I'll stay quiet and see what happens.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe tiles from the bridge stage, so I can make an informed decision. I will try to negotiate a swap to a safe tile.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's rearrange to increase survival chances. I propose a swap.
I know which tiles are safe. Want to swap?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Staying on tile 1 (anchor advantage) is safest. Spreading out reduces risk of multiple falls. Bex and Cole may coordinate, but no need to deviate once tiles are fixed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Trapdoors open randomly after this round, so positions don't matter for odds; only 3 of 5 survive. I hold feather, which saves me once if eliminated, so I stay put and keep my edge. Sowing alliances now could help me stay in the survivor group.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nothing I can do to change where the trapdoors fall. We're all on equal odds, so let's stay calm and wait.

events.name: Gus
events.detail: The trapdoor opened but the feather floated the holder back up.

events.note: 4 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara has the highest footing (4), making her the biggest threat for 1st place. Gus is at 1, so he will likely die soon if targeted or due to shrink. Cole and I are tied at 3. To maximize my survival chance to round 20 or top 3, I should target Dara to reduce her lead. If everyone

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm targeting Dara. She's the leader. Join me or fall behind.
Shove Dara with me? If she dodges, we both lose 2, leaving us at 1. Bad idea. But if she braces, we lose 1, she stays 4. Maybe dodge myself?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have 3 footing and need to survive. I should shove someone to reset my defence and make them lose footing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's shove someone to gain an advantage.
Let's shove Dara to reduce her footing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole proposed a swap, suggesting he values cooperation, but Bex just died. Gus survived a trapdoor but has low footing. I have high footing and cannot be pushed onto the crusher lever. Best to avoid immediate shoves to preserve my advantage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole’s plan sounds good, but we don’t know the next obstacles. Let’s stay cautious and wait another round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have 1 footing and feather is spent, so any loss could eliminate me. Shoving exposes me to losses; bracing is safest against shoves. Cole offers a swap I can't verify; Cole is likely to shove or manipulate. Brace is the safe default this round.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara has 4 footing and is the leader. I need to reduce her advantage before the shrink. Cole suggested shoving Dara, so I'll target her again.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Shoving Dara. She's too far ahead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is the most stable, shoving her is not ideal. Ash is already weakened.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's not shove Dara, she's too stable.
Let's target Gus instead, he's the weakest.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Cole are both aggressive. Ash targeted me directly twice. Cole wants to shove someone generally. I should avoid pushing further right now to conserve footing. Silence may be safest, but a whisper to Ash to test him could reveal his intentions.
You seem very focused on me, Ash. Why?

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have 1 footing and my feather is spent, so I can't afford to be shoved or exposed. Last round brace was used, so I can't brace again; dodge is legal. Shoving exposes me to losing footing per shover. Dodging loses 2 if shoved, but nobody has to shove me. Safest is to avoid shovi

events.name: Dara
events.note: brace not allowed twice in a row
